metadata.description: DesignAgent — build and review Figma designs with Claude Code.

plugins.name: designagent
plugins.description: Claude Code's live bridge to Figma: read, build, and edit the canvas in real time, and exchange a design-system-faithful DESIGN.md spec to build production UI from. Includes the design-to-code skill and the designagent MCP server.

plugins.name: designreview
plugins.description: AI design review inside Claude Code — reviews design intent, not pixels. Connects PRD, research, Figma, and analytics to surface gaps before handoff or launch. Reads and annotates Figma through the DesignAgent bridge. Run /new, /review, /annotate.
